mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portal_content (content_type, category_id, title, summary, cover_url, content_html, extension_json, status, sort_order, published_at, created_by) VALUES (#{contentType}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{coverUrl}, #{contentHtml}, #{extensionJson}, #{status}, #{sortOrder}, #{publishedAt}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE portal_content SET deleted = 1, deleted_time = NOW(), deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, purge_after_time = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE portal_content SET deleted = 0, deleted_time = NULL, deleted_by = NULL, purge_after_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM portal_content WHERE deleted = 1 ORDER BY deleted_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM portal_content WHERE deleted = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM portal_content WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
